metadata.description: Claude Code mods: talk to Claude in your own language while it works in English, and turn any answer into a sourced report on demand.

plugins.name: cc-trans
plugins.description: Write and read in your own language while Claude works in English: prompts go out translated, replies come back with a translation, code untouched.

plugins.name: cc-report
plugins.description: A report button under each answer: a fork of the main thread rewrites the answer as a short, sourced report in a side pane, reusing the prompt cache and leaving the conversation untouched.
